newsitem.title: ITALY: Rome airports see only slight 1996 air cargo rise.
newsitem.headline: Rome airports see only slight 1996 air cargo rise.

text.p: Total cargo traffic handled by Rome's Fiumicino and Ciampino airports was 267,328 tons in 1996, up 1.2 percent on the previous year, said ADR, the company responsible for their management.
At Fiumicino, 1996 cargo rose by 0.9 percent to 259,353 tonnes while postal traffic was up 18.8 percent to 40,816 tonnes and passengers handled up 9.2 percent to 23 million.
At the city's Ciampino airport, the increase in cargo traffic last year was 13.3 percent over 1995 to 8,075 tonnes, while passenger traffic rose 0.8 percent to 813,911.
